purpose: Define the contract foundation for the FUTURE Guild War auto-resolve replay/view link. Guild War remains the only auto-resolve exception, but every Guild War battle must expose a view/replay entrypoint backed by the Generic Visual Battle Runner (view-only). This pack is design/contract/audit-only; no Guild War runtime mutation; no live /battle-replay route created.

future_flow.step_1: Guild War service issues auto-resolve battle; on completion it freezes attacker_snapshot, defender_snapshot, precomputed log/seed, result_summary, and war_score_delta_display_only.
future_flow.step_2: Guild War service emits a server-issued guild_war_battle_id and a battle_instance_id for the Generic Visual Battle Runner.
future_flow.step_3: Players can deeplink/open /battle-replay?guild_war_battle_id=... in a FUTURE runtime pack.
future_flow.step_4: Generic Visual Battle Runner mounts in viewer_kind=guild_war_view and renders the frozen replay payload.
future_flow.step_5: Replay/view never re-runs the battle, never grants rewards, never mutates war score or guild points.
